story.text: 승객 여러분, 드디어 저희 서울 노선의 마지막 구간입니다. 오늘은 서울에서 가장 화려한 밤을 보여드릴게요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, deu-di-eo jeo-hui seo-ul no-seon-ui ma-ji-mak gu-gan-im-ni-da.
story.en: Passengers, this is finally the last leg of our Seoul route. Today I'll show you Seoul's most spectacular night.

story.text: 해가 지면 도시 전체에 불빛이 켜지는 '야경'이 펼쳐져요. 낮과는 완전히 다른 서울이 되죠.
story.reading: hae-ga ji-myeon do-si jeon-che-e bul-bich-i kyeo-ji-neun ya-gyeong-i pyeol-cheo-jyeo-yo.
story.en: When the sun sets, the 'night view' unfolds as lights turn on across the whole city — a completely different Seoul from daytime.

story.text: 매년 가을이면 한강에서 '불꽃축제'가 열려요. 수십만 명이 밤하늘을 함께 올려다보는 순간이죠.
story.en: Every autumn, the 'fireworks festival' is held at the Han River — a moment when hundreds of thousands look up at the sky together.

story.text: 가장 좋은 자리는 역시 '한강공원'이에요. 돗자리 하나만 있으면 특등석이 완성돼요.
story.en: The best spot is definitely 'Han River Park'. All you need is a picnic mat for a front-row seat.

story.text: 그리고 이런 밤엔 '치맥'이 빠질 수 없죠. 치킨과 맥주, 최고의 조합이에요!
story.reading: geu-ri-go i-reon bam-en chi-maeg-i ppa-jil su eop-jyo.
story.en: And on a night like this, 'chimaek' (chicken and beer) is a must. Chicken and beer — the perfect combo!

story.text: 자, 이걸로 규현 기장과의 서울 여행이 '마무리'됩니다. 함께해주셔서 정말 감사했어요.
story.reading: ja, i-geol-lo gyu-hyeon gi-jang-gwa-ui seo-ul yeo-haeng-i ma-mu-ri-doem-ni-da.
story.en: Well, this brings our Seoul journey with Captain Kyuhyun to a 'wrap-up'. Thank you so much for joining me.

story.text: 서울에서의 모든 순간, 즐거우셨죠? 마지막으로 오늘 배운 단어들로 문제를 풀어봐요!
story.en: Did you enjoy every moment in Seoul? Let's finish up by solving some questions with today's words!

words.example_en: Seoul's night view is really beautiful.
The Han River fireworks festival is held every autumn.
I spread a mat and sit at Han River Park.
Chimaek is a must on fireworks festival day.

words.example: 이제 규현 기장과의 서울 여행을 마무리할 시간이에요.
words.example_reading: i-je gyu-hyeon gi-jang-gwa-ui seo-ul yeo-haeng-eul ma-mu-ri-hal si-gan-i-e-yo
words.example_en: It's time to wrap up the Seoul trip with Captain Kyuhyun.

sentences.ko: 야경을 보러 전망 좋은 곳을 찾아갑니다.
sentences.reading: ya-gyeong-eul bo-reo jeon-mang jo-eun gos-eul chaj-a-gam-ni-da
sentences.en: I go find a spot with a good view to see the night scenery.
On fireworks festival day, the Han River is packed with people.
I spread a mat and wait at Han River Park.
Chimaek pairs really well with summer nights.
We end the trip while exchanging closing greetings.
